name: isIdentityProfileSyncEnabled
definition: At least one JumpCloud identity provider is configured and not disabled.
evidenceRequiredForTrue: at least one provider whose disabled field is not true

changeLog.change: Registered at V0 so the key stops being grandfathered by the allowlist; proposed, single emitter, definition taken from the emitting transform.

notes: Records that a provider is enabled, not that it has synced recently.
